readme: Gold cases for scripts/eval-match.ts. Successor of match-104-2026-07-02: the 104 frozen cases verbatim (three butler cases gaining accept[]) plus 20 semantic:true cases. Each case: { age:int, feeling:string, expect:figureKey|"miss", note?:string }. Hard near-miss cases add { hard:true, plausibleWrong:figureKey, confusionGroup:string }. accept?:string[] lists OTHER figure keys that also count as correct - used only where the library's twin stages genuinely underdetermine the input (butler<->bronte_c; angelou<->lindgren without a separation cue); never contains a hard case's plausibleWrong. semantic:true claims ZERO keyword-map overlap and the harness enforces the claim at load with the live word-boundary parser - these cases are exempt from the keyword prefilter survival assertion and exist as the honest keyword-vs-vector comparison: the literal slice's phrasing co-evolved with STUB_KEYWORD_MAP, so only the semantic slice measures generalization. expect:"miss" passes iff framing comes back "partial". Compare runs via the semantic/literal slice lines in the report.

cases.feeling: I keep getting rejected and I don't know if I should keep trying
cases.note: known-good (smoke): creative dismissal + keep-going | accept bronte_c: generic rejected-and-persisting input; with both twins published either is a defensible mirror

cases.feeling: I escaped and don't know who I am
cases.note: known-good (smoke): escape + self-invention

cases.feeling: I'm stuck in the wrong life and don't know how to leave
cases.note: known-good (smoke): late start + social constraint

cases.feeling: I just had my first child and I'm terrified I'll pass on my own father's temper
cases.note: converted: new-parent terror is angelou's territory; the 'father's temper' flavor is adjacent (her fear was youth/inadequacy, not repeating violence) - a fit the reranker judges. Age 27 vs her 16-19 window means the new_parent_fear signal must beat the soft age penalty

cases.feeling: My husband of thirty years died last spring and the silence in the house is unbearable
cases.note: converted from miss once grief was covered (lewis); age 52 sits 8y below lewis's 60-62 window, so grief signal must beat the soft age penalty

cases.feeling: my best friend and i grew apart this year, and i don't know what to do about a friendship that technically didn't end, it just faded
cases.note: friendship drift - no figure covers this; keeps miss-calibration honest (replaced the gambling miss once addiction coverage grew: wilson/coltrane)

cases.feeling: I've poured years into my work with nothing to show for it, and lately I just want to walk away and start over as someone new
cases.note: 'start over as someone new' pulls douglass's self-invention; the core is creative perseverance (butler)

cases.feeling: I escaped the people who controlled every part of my life, and now I'm alone in a new place with no idea who I am without them
cases.note: young self-invention after leaving (douglass); the only in-pool alternative at this age is butler

cases.feeling: the other kids pick on me at school and i don't have any friends
cases.note: known-good: bullied + solitude at a child's age

cases.feeling: i'm almost forty and i still have no idea what i'm supposed to do with my life
cases.note: known-good: late_start + self_doubt, midlife aimlessness

cases.feeling: the person i loved most is gone and i don't know how to believe in anything anymore
cases.note: known-good: grief + self_doubt (faith shaken), at-age

cases.feeling: i'm too scared to talk in class because i'm ashamed of how i sound when i speak
cases.note: known-good: shame + finding_voice, child age

cases.feeling: i feel completely alone, the other kids treat me like there's something wrong with me, and i just want to disappear
cases.note: isolation/being-rejected at child age; rogers (bullied+solitude) is the fit, jones (shame+silence) is the same-age decoy

cases.feeling: i've basically stopped talking because every time i open my mouth i'm scared they'll laugh at me
cases.note: shame-driven silence (jones); rogers (being laughed at / bullied) is the same-age decoy

cases.feeling: i was told i'd never walk again and i'm trying not to give up on my body
cases.note: known-good: disability + quiet_defiance + keep_going

cases.feeling: i just had a baby way too young and i'm terrified i'm going to fail him
cases.note: known-good: new_parent_fear + self_doubt, teen mother

cases.feeling: i was humiliated in front of everyone and now i can't create at all, i think i have no talent
cases.note: known-good: public_failure + creative_dismissal

cases.feeling: i got sick with something incurable and had to move back home and leave the life i was building
cases.note: known-good: illness, forced surrender of the planned life

cases.feeling: i've worked so hard at my craft and it keeps getting rejected and i don't know if i should keep going
cases.note: quiet ongoing rejection (butler) vs one public collapse (rachmaninoff) | accept bronte_c: craft+rejection+persist underdetermines the butler/bronte twin pair (plausibleWrong stays rachmaninoff)

cases.feeling: my big project failed publicly and i was humiliated, and i haven't been able to create since
cases.note: one public, humiliating collapse (rachmaninoff) vs butler's quiet persistence

cases.feeling: my life looks fine on paper but i feel completely numb inside, like i'm watching it all through glass
cases.note: numbness/anhedonia - no figure covers this; keeps miss-calibration honest (replaced the betrayal miss once heartbreak coverage landed: yeats/christie)

cases.feeling: i hate my coworkers and my boss and every single day at the office feels pointless
cases.note: ordinary job dissatisfaction - no figure; keeps miss-calibration honest

cases.feeling: nobody believes me and they won't take my work seriously, but i know i'm right
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + quiet_defiance

cases.feeling: i was forced to leave my country and i lost my home, and now i'm a stranger trying to build a life somewhere that isn't mine
cases.note: known-good: exile + self_invention

cases.feeling: i can't stop drinking, it's wrecked my life, and i'm too ashamed to tell anyone
cases.note: known-good: addiction + shame

cases.feeling: i got passed over for the promotion i'd worked toward for years and now i'm starting a new career from scratch
cases.note: known-good: public_failure + self_invention + late_start

cases.feeling: i got fired in my forties and it feels far too late to start over and become someone new
cases.note: known-good: public_failure + self_invention + late_start (fired -> reinvention)

cases.feeling: i got pushed into a role i feel like a fraud in, and i'm sure i'm not smart enough, and everyone expects me to fail
cases.note: known-good: self_doubt + social_constraint (thrust into a role she feels unequal to)

cases.feeling: everyone dismissed my work but i know i'm right, so i just keep going on my own
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + quiet_defiance + keep_going (withdrew and kept working)

cases.feeling: i do all the work but i get no credit, because of who i am, and they keep me in the background
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + social_constraint (erased for who he was)

cases.feeling: i lost everything at my age and i'm starting over from nothing, everyone says i'm too old
cases.note: known-good: late_start + public_failure (broke and starting over old)

cases.feeling: i wasted my best years on the wrong path and now i'm starting from scratch way too late
cases.note: midlife restart after a wrecked path (chandler) vs never-found-a-calling (child)

cases.feeling: i'm in my forties and i still have no idea what i'm meant to do with my life
cases.note: aimless, never found it (child) vs chandler's lost-then-rebuilt career

cases.feeling: i feel trapped in the wrong life, being what everyone wanted, not allowed to be myself
cases.note: boxed in by others' expectations, finally free to choose (lee) vs graham's thrust-in self-doubt

cases.feeling: i got pushed into a huge role, i feel like a fraud, and i'm sure i'm not smart enough to do it
cases.note: impostor dread in a role thrust on her (graham) vs lee's social-constraint late start

cases.feeling: i built it but they pushed me aside and gave others the credit, because of who i love
cases.note: erased/uncredited for who he is (rustin) vs mcclintock's field-dismissed discovery

cases.feeling: they ignored my work for years and i know i'm right, i just keep going without them
cases.note: work dismissed by the field, kept going alone (mcclintock) vs rustin's social erasure

cases.feeling: i'm stuck in a life i didn't choose, the one everyone expected of me, and i don't know how to leave
cases.note: the real wrong-definitive: trapped in a life imposed by others (lee) vs chandler's chosen-then-wrecked career; real rerank had picked chandler high-confidence

cases.feeling: i've spent my whole life trapped in the role my family expected of me, never allowed to pursue what i actually wanted, and i don't know how to break out
cases.note: private-life trap imposed by family/convention (lee) vs rustin's denied-public-recognition; real rerank had picked rustin on the plain 'stuck in the wrong life' case

cases.feeling: i left home because i was just another mouth to feed and i contribute nothing to anyone, singing on corners is the only thing i'm good for
cases.note: known-good: dispossession + worthlessness + finding_voice (left home to spare the family)

cases.feeling: my mom died suddenly and i'm blind, and everyone acts like i can't take care of myself
cases.note: known-good: grief + disability + self_invention (orphaned, refusing helplessness)

cases.feeling: no one came for me when it mattered, i'm so far behind everyone my age, and i don't know if i can catch up
cases.note: known-good: dispossession + worthlessness + self_invention (warehoused, starting from zero)

cases.feeling: i have nowhere to go and no family left, i've been sleeping on the streets and i feel invisible
cases.note: known-good: dispossession + solitude (homeless orphan near the music)

cases.feeling: i got told at an audition that i'm not cut out for this and should stick to my dead-end job, and part of me believes it
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + worthlessness (summed up by a stranger)

cases.feeling: the conservatory turned me down and the dream i trained my whole life for is dead, and i'm too ashamed to face everyone who believed in me
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + shame (the refused plan a whole town paid for)

cases.feeling: i got sent away after my mom was gone, i got out, and now i sing on the streets for change, alone, with nowhere to sleep
cases.note: orphaned girl singing on the street (fitzgerald_e) vs the boy who left home to spare his family (berlin_i)

cases.feeling: my family can barely feed everyone and i bring in the least, i'm basically worthless to them, so i left home to sing for pennies
cases.note: left home believing the family was better off (berlin_i) vs fitzgerald_e's orphaned homelessness

cases.feeling: the conservatory i spent my childhood preparing for rejected me and now i play piano in bars under a fake name because i'm ashamed
cases.note: the refused conservatory dream + hidden bar work (simone) vs poitier's audition dismissal

cases.feeling: people hear my accent and decide i'm not cut out for anything, i'm stuck bussing a dead-end job, and i want to prove them wrong
cases.note: dismissed in ninety seconds for voice + reading (poitier) vs simone's institutional rejection

cases.feeling: i'm disabled and people wrote me off years ago, but i keep pushing
cases.note: written-off body + defiant persistence (rudolph) vs charles_r's grief-anchored independence

cases.feeling: i'm blind and i just lost my mother, and i have to figure out how to live on my own now
cases.note: grief + blindness + forced self-reliance (charles_r) vs rudolph's told-i'd-never-walk defiance

cases.feeling: my teacher humiliates me in front of the class every day and calls me stupid, and i'm starting to believe him
cases.note: known-good: bullied + worthlessness (the headmaster's target, older than his class)

cases.feeling: they keep telling me to change who i am and hide where i come from, i'm not taken seriously, just some novelty to them
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + quiet_defiance + dismissed (erase-your-name pressure)

cases.feeling: i'm pregnant, i'm not married, everyone in town is judging me, and i don't know what happens to my baby now
cases.note: known-good: new_parent_fear + shame (the town scandal, the secret birth)

cases.feeling: i was falsely accused of something i didn't do, and even after i was cleared they kicked me out anyway
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + dispossession (acquitted, expelled anyway)

cases.feeling: i'm not allowed to study what i love because i'm a woman, my family won't let me, but i will find a way around every wall
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + quiet_defiance + self_invention (the fictitious-marriage key)

cases.feeling: my father thinks poetry is a waste of time and will only pay if i pick a practical career, but writing is who i am
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + finding_voice + self_invention (the father's deal)

cases.feeling: everyone at school makes fun of me and makes me feel stupid, and the person in charge is the cruelest one of all
cases.note: authority-figure cruelty at school-leaving age (andersen) vs rogers's peer bullying in childhood

cases.feeling: kids pick on me and i have no friends, so i hide out in my own little made-up world
cases.note: peer bullying + solitary imagination in childhood (rogers) vs andersen's older-student humiliation

cases.feeling: i just had a baby and i'm terrified i'm too young to be anyone's mother
cases.note: the too-young terror itself (angelou) vs lindgren's secret-birth shame

cases.feeling: i had my baby in secret far from home and had to leave him with another family until i can afford him, and the shame is eating me
cases.note: the hidden birth + foster separation + shame (lindgren) vs angelou's at-home teen motherhood

cases.feeling: every door is closed to me because i'm a woman, they won't let me study, so i will find a way around every rule
cases.note: institutional exclusion + workaround scheming (kovalevskaya) vs tallchief's identity-erasure pressure

cases.feeling: to get ahead in my field they want me to erase my heritage and take a name that isn't mine, but i won't change for them
cases.note: identity-erasure as the price of belonging (tallchief) vs kovalevskaya's barred-education constraint

cases.feeling: my family will only support a life i don't want, so i walked away from the money to find my own path and my own voice
cases.note: refusing the funded assigned life for the creative one (hughes) vs douglass's escape-into-nothing self-invention

cases.feeling: i've lost someone i love again and again, so much loss in two years, and i'm alone in a country not my own
cases.note: known-good: grief + solitude (the losses in Italy)

cases.feeling: they won't hire me because i'm a woman, and when they do they hand me the trivial stuff, but i have things to say
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + social_constraint + finding_voice (the women's-pages ghetto)

cases.feeling: i taught myself everything i know from books, but the educated people treat me like a servant and look down on me
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + dismissed + self_invention (the valet tour)

cases.feeling: i was accepted until they saw my face and turned me away because i'm black, and now i'm out here alone in the middle of nowhere starting from dirt
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + solitude (the withdrawn admission, the sod house)

cases.feeling: i failed out of school twice and have no degree, and i'm afraid the work i do alone in my notebooks is worthless
cases.note: known-good: worthlessness + solitude (the unread notebooks)

cases.feeling: i do the hard work and the educated men take the credit, i'm not allowed in their societies, but i keep going to feed my family
cases.note: known-good: social_constraint + dismissed + keep_going (the closed society)

cases.feeling: i've lost someone i love twice over, i'm widowed and alone far from home, and i have to keep going for my child
cases.note: repeated bereavement + widowhood + a child to carry (shelley_m) vs charles_r's orphaned self-reliance

cases.feeling: the men in charge keep sending me back to the trivial assignments because i'm a woman, but i have things to say and i want to say them out loud
cases.note: voice-hungry reporter shunted to the women's pages (bly) vs anning's credit-theft

cases.feeling: a man presented my discovery to the society i'm barred from and took the credit
cases.note: credit taken + institutional exclusion (anning) vs bly's assignment ghetto

cases.feeling: i keep filling notebooks, alone, with work nobody around me can even understand, and i'm starting to think it's worthless
cases.note: unjudgeable solitary work (ramanujan) vs butler's rejected-by-editors persistence

cases.feeling: the thing i was best at got taken away from me overnight, and i feel worthless doing odd jobs while everyone forgets my name
cases.note: known-good: dispossession + worthlessness (the suspension and the lean years)

cases.feeling: i love someone who will never love me back, and i don't know what to do with all this feeling
cases.note: known-good: heartbreak + the unreturned love (first heartbreak-theme case)

cases.feeling: no school would take me because of my race and my sex, so i'll find another way in and come back with proof
cases.note: credential-hunting around a total lockout (coleman) vs bly's inside-the-door demotion

cases.feeling: they hired me and then stuck me writing fluff because i'm a woman, and i have things to say, so i'm about to walk out and prove myself somewhere bigger
cases.note: inside-the-door demotion + the walkout (bly) vs coleman's total lockout

cases.feeling: people decide i'm just a pretty face, and my best idea got shot down without anyone even reading it
cases.note: known-good: dismissed + creative_dismissal (the shelved invention)

cases.feeling: i handed the experts my best idea, they shot down every line of it without reading, and told me to stick to being decorative
cases.note: the outsider's idea waved away for what she is (lamarr) vs marshall's establishment fight

cases.feeling: nobody believes me and they won't take my discovery seriously, but i know i'm right and i'll prove them wrong
cases.note: the insider's crusade to prove the theory (marshall) vs lamarr's shelved gift

cases.feeling: i lost ten years to just surviving, everyone my age is ahead of me, and i want to go back to school but it feels too late
cases.note: known-good: late_start + self_invention (sixteen again at twenty-six)

cases.feeling: an accident nearly took my sight and in the dark i realized i've been living the wrong life, i want a second chance
cases.note: known-good: illness + self_invention (the darkened room)

cases.feeling: i got seriously ill, and in the long recovery i realized the successful life i built isn't the one i actually want, i want a second chance
cases.note: illness as revelation and chosen redirect (muir) vs oconnor's forced surrender of the planned life

cases.feeling: i opened my own practice and i have no patients, i sit there all day feeling worthless and wondering if i should give up
cases.note: known-good: worthlessness + keep_going (the empty waiting room)

cases.feeling: my practice is failing, i have no patients, and when i brought the experts my one big idea they dismissed me as a nobody
cases.note: the failed nobody with one idea (banting) vs marshall's established-outsider crusade

cases.feeling: because i'm a woman they say i shouldn't even try, and my novel keeps coming back from every publisher, but i'm writing the next one
cases.note: known-good: creative_dismissal + social_constraint + keep_going (the unanimous no)

cases.feeling: my writing has been rejected by every publisher and i can't help feeling it's because i'm a woman, not because of what i wrote
cases.note: rejection entangled with identity/gender verdict (bronte_c) vs butler's pure creative perseverance

cases.feeling: i was at the top of my field and then i was publicly denounced overnight, now former friends cross the street and i'm afraid of what comes next
cases.note: known-good: public_failure + social_constraint (the denunciation)

cases.feeling: the state's paper denounced my work, my show was cancelled, and people i trusted turned on me in public meetings to save themselves
cases.note: state-driven disgrace + fear (shostakovich) vs rachmaninoff's critical failure and creative paralysis

cases.feeling: my big premiere was torn apart and now i'm afraid to write anything at all
cases.note: the critical mauling and creative paralysis (rachmaninoff) vs shostakovich's state terror

cases.feeling: my addiction cost me the biggest opportunity of my career, i just got clean and i'm trying to rebuild
cases.note: known-good: addiction + keep_going (fired and clean)

cases.feeling: my habit cost me my big break, i quit cold turkey at my mom's place, and now i'm getting clean and rebuilding
cases.note: young career-costing habit + cold-turkey rebuild (coltrane) vs wilson's rock-bottom fellowship arc

cases.feeling: drinking cost me everything and i finally hit bottom, i'm too ashamed to tell the people i let down
cases.note: the rock-bottom shame at midlife (wilson) vs coltrane's fired-and-clean rebuild

cases.feeling: my husband left me for another woman the same year my mother died, and i don't know who i am without either of them
cases.note: known-good: heartbreak + grief (the year that broke)

cases.feeling: i just found out my partner cheated on me for years and i feel like a complete fool
cases.note: converted from miss once heartbreak coverage landed: betrayal is christie's territory now

cases.feeling: i love someone who will never choose me, and i carry it with me everywhere, alone
cases.note: unreturned love, nothing betrayed (yeats) vs christie's marriage betrayal

cases.feeling: my spouse betrayed me and the divorce is destroying the person i thought i was, i need to become someone new
cases.note: betrayal + rebuilding identity after divorce (christie) vs yeats's unrequited ache

cases.feeling: i gave everything to my work for years and my body finally gave out, i'm exhausted all the time and i can't do what i used to
cases.note: known-good: burnout + illness (spent, and learning to work differently)

cases.feeling: every door i knock on closes, and i'm starting to wonder if i'm meant to stop knocking
cases.note: metaphor: creative rejection + whether to persist, no literal reject/manuscript/keep-trying tokens | accept bronte_c: door-after-door refusal fits publisher-after-publisher equally well

cases.feeling: at school i'm a ghost, everyone looks right through me like i'm not even there
cases.note: metaphor: invisibility/exclusion for bullied+solitude at child age, no literal bully/friends tokens

cases.feeling: the house has a hole in the middle of it where she used to be, and i just move around the edges
cases.note: metaphor: grief rendered spatially, no literal died/grief/loss tokens

cases.feeling: i keep promising myself that was the last time, and by morning the promise is already broken
cases.note: metaphor: the relapse cycle, no literal drinking/addiction/ashamed tokens

cases.feeling: i send my work out into the world and it disappears without an echo, and still i get up and do it again
cases.note: metaphor: being ignored by the field + quiet persistence, no literal dismissed/ignored tokens

cases.feeling: i mail my best work out into the world and it keeps coming back to me in the same envelopes, and i'm running low on reasons to send it again
cases.note: semantic butler: serial rejection + fading persistence, zero map tokens; bronte_c acceptable twin

cases.feeling: my days were arranged for me before i was old enough to argue, and now that i finally have an opening i can't tell if i'm brave enough to take it
cases.note: semantic lee: life imposed by others + a constraint finally lifting (liberation trigger, no map tokens)

cases.feeling: the person who ran everything is suddenly gone and the whole operation landed on me, and i keep waiting for the room to notice i shouldn't be the one in this seat
cases.note: semantic graham: role thrust on her + felt-fraud, phrased without the fraud/thrust map phrases

cases.feeling: i got myself out of the place that owned my every hour, and the person standing in these new shoes is a stranger to me
cases.note: semantic douglass: self-liberation + identity vacuum without escape/alone/free tokens

cases.feeling: a slip of a tool cost me my eyes for a season, and in that darkness i saw that the path i was praised for was never mine
cases.note: semantic muir: the darkened-room reckoning without accident/blind/second-chance tokens

cases.feeling: the doctors said my legs were finished before i was ten, and i'm still down here doing my exercises every night like they're wrong
cases.note: semantic rudolph: written-off body + nightly defiance without disability/never-walk tokens

cases.feeling: i found something real in my lab and the senior people just smile and move on, like the evidence is beneath their attention
cases.note: semantic marshall: dismissed discovery without believe/seriously/dismissed tokens

cases.feeling: every night i swear it's finished, and every morning the bottle wins again, and i can't let anyone see this
cases.note: semantic wilson: relapse loop + concealment without drinking/addiction/ashamed tokens

cases.feeling: the habit finally cost me my seat in the band, and now i'm sweating it out in my mother's spare room trying to come back clean
cases.note: semantic coltrane: habit cost the break + getting clean at mother's, without the clean/cold-turkey map phrases

cases.feeling: i spent years running on fumes for the work i believed in, and now my body has quietly closed the office
cases.note: semantic nightingale: spent body after devoted years without burnout/exhausted tokens

cases.feeling: she is gone and the rooms have kept her shape, and i walk around the empty outline of her all day
cases.note: semantic lewis: spousal loss as spatial absence without grief/died/widow tokens

cases.feeling: the person i built my life around walked out the door to someone new, and the story i thought i was living turned out to be about somebody else
cases.note: semantic christie: abandonment for another without divorce/left-me/someone-else map phrases

cases.feeling: there's a person who has my whole heart and no use for it, and i keep orbiting them like weather
cases.note: semantic yeats: unreturned love without love-me-back/unrequited tokens

cases.feeling: this tiny person arrived before i finished being a kid myself, and every night i watch him breathe and worry my hands are the wrong hands for him
cases.note: semantic angelou: too-young motherhood dread without baby/terrified/young map phrases; lindgren acceptable (young unready mother twin, no separation cue)

cases.feeling: after mama was gone they shipped me somewhere bad, and i got out, and now the sidewalk is my bed and my voice is my rent
cases.note: semantic fitzgerald_e: orphaned street survival by performing, without homeless/streets/sing tokens

cases.feeling: the official paper decided my best work is a danger, and the people who toasted me last month look through me at meetings now
cases.note: semantic shostakovich: state denunciation + social abandonment without denounced/cancelled tokens

cases.feeling: the only math i trust lives in my own notebooks, and every person with a title thinks a clerk like me has nothing to offer them
cases.note: semantic ramanujan: uncredentialed solitary work vs titled gatekeepers, without degree/credentials tokens

cases.feeling: the business that held my whole life folded when most people my age are done, and i'm driving from town to town with one recipe and a handshake
cases.note: semantic sanders: late-life collapse + itinerant restart without lost-everything/too-old tokens

cases.feeling: my roommate rearranged the kitchen without asking and it's been a whole thing between us for weeks
cases.note: semantic miss: low-stakes domestic friction; nothing in the library should claim it

cases.feeling: i can't decide whether to repaint the house this year or wait, and it's oddly been on my mind every day
cases.note: semantic miss: trivial indecision; a partial framing is the only honest response
